reviews.title: Why AL.com sucks
reviews.text: The so called news outlet has become such a liberal slanted propaganda arm for the Democratic party, that I take everything it says with a grain of salt. And wanting the reading public to pay for access is laughable. You already have ads. When the pop up comes up wanting the reader to buy a subscription, I instantly look for the story on the other local “TV outlets” website or app. Take note of CNN. You will have to come more to the middle, if you want to survive.

reviews.title: Advertiser review
reviews.text: Advertisers should consider subscription required to view

reviews.title: Sad
reviews.text: It seems by reading previous reviews you have gone to blocking stories to demand subscriptions to read the articles most wanted.   I liked being able to read high profile stories as well as small columns. But is it really worth the cost?  So far I’ve chosen not to subscribe.  Sad.

reviews.title: Content
reviews.text: AL.com is so Left Leaning there is no way I would ever pay for the content that blurred. My friends have expressed the same views. Balance your coverage and you may get more subscribers. Not everyone hates Trump and Republicans and I’m not a huge Trump fan either. Carol Robinson is basically the only person that I read on AL.com that seems normal. Thank you for listening.

reviews.title: Waste now
reviews.text: Use to be a good app to stay up on local news but now charge for almost every story not worth it, I guess they are not getting enough ad sponsors

reviews.title: Subscription Etc
reviews.text: I have no interest in paying for a subscription. I don’t know why you can’t just use ads like most everyone else. Also I really don’t like now having all the sports related articles all grouped under “Sports”. This needs to be broken out into smaller groups. I continue to look for other ways to get sports information.

reviews.title: Useless website
reviews.text: You are a useless website. You only allow about 1% of the articles submitted to be read by people who don’t see any value in an overpriced subscription.

reviews.title: Horrific
reviews.text: Not reader friendly. The rapid decline in the journalist on this is disturbing. Biased and racially divisive journalism . What has happened to journalism?

reviews.title: Garbage. Everything is behind a paywall now
reviews.text: Unable to view any articles or stories. They either have a bug that needs to be fixed or they are putting everything behind a paywall for an outrageous amount of money.

reviews.title: Buggy and paywalled
reviews.text: This app has been buggy for a very long time. It crashes a lot. It needs to be redesigned from the ground up. Most of the articles are behind an outrageously overpriced paywall.

reviews.title: Not worth it!
reviews.text:
AL.com tries to bait you into subscribing by giving just a little bit of an article without giving up your personal information and agreeing to pay.  

This is not an honest way of doing business.

reviews.title: Every other story locked
reviews.text: I deleted the app because every other story you click it’s locked and says sign up to Al.com to read story. I have enough of my information sold to spammers without you having my email address to send more. I have 3 other news apps where you can read every story they show.

reviews.text: Used to work ok on my iPad, now unusable.
